title: verbena tenera f. albiflora
intro: Verbena tenera f. albiflora, commonly known as white verbena, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Verbenaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of white verbena include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote a restful sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
